title: armeria macloviana subsp. californica
intro: Armeria macloviana subsp. californica, commonly known as the Western Sea Thrift or California Thrift, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
